_meta.baseline: master @ c38c606 (intended tag v5.1.1) + the later uncommitted fixes
_meta.claim: Exact equality on every published instant (int64 epoch ms) and every lord, rashi and Yogini name. No tolerance: the periods are Dates, and `new Date()`'s truncation quantises the float duration to a whole millisecond, three orders coarser than an ULP of the instant.
_meta.why: The five entry points used to read an argless `new Date()`, so `currentIndex` and its companions were masked and re-derived at fixed pins. `asOfDate` (2026-08-24) removed the need: every result here is taken as of `asOf` below and the four leaves are ordinary pinned values. The generator still asserts the library agrees with `dashaIndexAt` at that instant, and `pinOffsets` still walks the rule across the whole arc, which one instant cannot. Every antardasha of every mahadasha is carried leaf-for-leaf rather than digested, because a digest cannot distinguish a lord rotation or a clip-count change from a value change, and both are one transposed index away.
